lead.headline: METR: Anthropic is improving models ~2× faster — and AI is doing most of the accelerating
lead.summary: After an 11-week high-access look inside Anthropic, METR estimates capabilities on well-specified tasks are growing at about twice the March 2024–Oct 2025 rate (AECI 1.9×, 95% CI 1.5–2.8×). They guess a majority (~80%) of today's acceleration comes from AI used in R&D, not faster compute scaling — and they saw no clear bottlenecks that would stop it compounding. Anthropic redacted much of the most informative evidence.

number_of_day.label: Estimated acceleration in Anthropic AECI benchmark growth since Oct 2025 vs the prior trend (95% CI 1.5–2.8×) — roughly two years of historical progress in one.

news.headline: GPT-6 Cyber ships for Daybreak Red: 48.5% ExploitGym, 81 novel Firefox bugs
news.summary: OpenAI's new cyber model scores 48.5% on ExploitGym (up from 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber) and stays in-scope on 99.93–100% of honeypot tests. It helped produce the 948 Linux LPEs and 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulns Mozilla has been patching. Initially API/Codex for approved Daybreak Red customers only; classified Critical under the Preparedness Framework.

news.headline: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: native 15-second video, conversational edits, 30% cheaper
news.summary: Google DeepMind's video model is generally available on the Gemini API and Cloud. Clips go to 15s (from 10s), with multi-turn conversational editing, stronger reference adherence, and $0.07/s for 720p — 30% below Omni 1.1. Draft at 360p/720p, then upscale to 1080p or 4K; outputs carry SynthID.

news.headline: Claude Personal Finance: read-only bank data via Plaid for US Pro/Max/Ultra
news.summary: Beta rolls out this week. Connect banks and cards through Plaid; Claude sees balances, credit limits, and up to two years of transactions — it cannot move or invest money. Hub chats aren't used for training; Anthropic pitches it as a first step toward working alongside licensed advisors.

news.headline: BackingMinds invests in Helsinki's Saidot — ownership and rules for every AI agent
news.summary: Nordic VC BackingMinds (fresh €50M first close of fund III, EIF-backed) backs Saidot's agent-governance stack: every agent gets an owner, mandate, and dependency record so policy-as-code can travel with models and tools. Crowberry and Ventic join; capital funds Europe strength, US expansion, and Gartner-listed Niche Player growth.

Agents have made it easier to write code, but most apps never make it off localhost. Describe the tool you want - Cursor will build it, set up a database, run deterministic and agentic security checks, and deploy. [...]

writers_corner.title: On confronting your soul in your creative work
writers_corner.take: Markert says New Orleans stripped New York survival mode so her In Rooms photography could face the psyche it had been circling — and that artists need each other more than solitary images do.
writers_corner.quote: New Orleans is a place to strip yourself of the survival skills of New York and confront your soul, which can be humbling.
